local_task_name.rule: manual overflow rejects; no silent truncation

reason_text.rule: required only where a reviewed correction/retention choice needs operator rationale; audit stores the bounded allowlisted reason field only

warning_summary.rule: generated from closed reason codes plus bounded identifiers, never arbitrary workbook/body content

time_bounds.local_input: IANA timezone + local wall time; nonexistent wall times reject and ambiguous wall times require explicit fold/offset choice
time_bounds.unknown: unknown/absent remains null and never becomes a fabricated instant

collection_bounds.rule: page limits constrain rendering/materialization only; exact totals, grouping authority, exports and persisted proposal membership are never inferred from one page
collection_bounds.grouping_workset_rule: the sweep-line algorithm is O(n log n); above the soft threshold computation must run as a durable bounded-memory job and may not fall back to O(n^2) pairwise comparison
collection_bounds.proposal_members: no product/business maximum; stored row-wise and paged deterministically

execution_bounds.bulk_start_tasks: one Objective execution command may start an explicitly selected persisted proposal/set; transport does not require one unbounded client array
execution_bounds.history_query: cursor paginated by immutable event identity/time ordering
execution_bounds.writer_rule: expensive grouping, diff, ordinal and preview calculation occurs outside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; commit revalidates only indexed affected state plus interval-overlap guards

timezone_setting.supported: any IANA zone resolvable by the packaged offline tzdata/ZoneInfo runtime, including Pacific/Galapagos
